Amapiano firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1

Four tracks, three synths and a drum machine with sixteen sounds on the white keys, twelve engines including six-operator FM and DX7 patches. This build carries gubhu's identity on SLOOP 2.8.5; the amapiano defaults are in progress, one issue each.

153sounds, 12 engines, your samples
37drum kits, 909 to afro, + your own
27punch-in fx: hold fx + key
recno click: the loop follows you
